items.title: The hom complex of a strictly perfect complex into a K-flat complex is again K-flat
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Sheaves)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that in the situation computing R-Hom out of a strictly perfect complex, if the representing complex of the target is K-flat then the resulting hom complex is K-flat as well. The proof identifies the hom complex with the SheafHom complex because boundedness of the strictly perfect complex turns the products in the definition into direct sums, then for an acyclic complex K^bullet considers the comparison map gamma from the total tensor product of K^bullet with the hom complex to the hom complex of the strictly perfect complex into the total tensor product, notes that the target is acyclic by K-flatness of the second argument, and reduces to showing that gamma is a quasi-isomorphism (proof lines 11838-11879). H2: the identification of the hom complex and the reduction to the acyclicity of gamma are the substance.
